reports.title: Warren Buffett: Ended Gates donations to give more to my children, not because of Epstein ties
reports.description: Berkshire Hathaway Chairman Warren Buffett joins 'Squawk Box' to discuss his current relationship with Bill Gates, how he came to the decision to cut the foundation from his giving plan this year, whether that is a permanent decision, and more.
